summary: Queues the order for shipment; returns 202 before any carrier call.

decisions.text: Only an order in state draft may ship; anything else is rejected.

boundary.text: Publishes shipment.dispatch onto the Redis queue.

unknowns.text: Nothing in this repository restricts who may call this route.
unknowns.why: No middleware on the route and no authorization check in the controller; a gateway in front of the service may or may not add one.

unknowns.text: The queue's retry policy is not visible here.
unknowns.why: Read from an environment variable that is not defined in this repository.

unknowns.text: Whether shipping stamps orders.shipped_at is not established here.
unknowns.why: The claim cited app/Domain/Order/Ship.php:30, which inserts into shipment_jobs; no write to orders.shipped_at appears at or around that line.
